evaluation.heldoutUse: Reported once after development selection; it is not used to choose h or modify coefficients.

limitations: The target estimates a causal conditional mean; it cannot recover phone identity discarded by the hard winner.
No avatar-only method can infer genuine future-phone anticipation from the current VRChat viseme index.
The selected SPIRE subset is English and does not establish universal language or accent coverage.
Oculus smoothing is already present in the teacher; selection is evaluated after the exact additional avatar observer.
Raw native weight mass is diagnostic only and is not a recovered VRChat parameter.

dataset.citation: Bandekar, J., Udupa, S., and Ghosh, P. K. (2024). Articulatory synthesis using representations learnt through phonetic label-aware contrastive loss. Proc. Interspeech 2024, 427-431.
dataset.sampleRateSource: Verified from processed frame counts against paired WAV duration (approximately 100 frames/s). The 62.5 Hz in Bandekar et al. section 3.4 describes a later synthesis/vocoder downsampling step, not the published processed .pt trajectory rate.
dataset.title: SPIRE EMA Corpus

provenance.licenseNotice: Derived from the SPIRE EMA Corpus paired audio, CC BY 4.0; Bandekar, Udupa, and Ghosh (2024).

subset.description: All splits are speaker- and sentence-disjoint. Fit uses prompt ordinals 0-63, held-out evaluation uses 64-95, and development uses 96-111.

training.fit: C[j] is the unweighted conditional barycenter of normalized native Oculus shapes whose hard winner is j. B(h)=(1-h)I+hC.

observer.formula: emitFast=S(fast); emitSlow=S(slow); output=(1-r)*emitSlow+r*emitFast; a=1-exp(-dt/tau); fast+=a*(B[winner]-fast); slow+=a*(fast-slow)
observer.interruption: A hard-winner edge changes only B[winner]. Fast and slow remain live and are never reset by a viseme transition.
observer.reset: fast and slow begin at exact one-hot silence only at controller initialization

sparseEmission.feedback: S is applied only to emitted copies, never to observer recurrence.
sparseEmission.formula: S(x)=0 when x<=epsilon, otherwise S(x)=(x-epsilon)/(1-epsilon) on sanitized [0,1]

observer.tracking: The render lead is multiplied by 1-trackingBlend and is therefore exactly zero for authoritative face tracking.

selectionObjective.sparseProjection: Retain the k largest conditional-barycenter coordinates, then apply exact Euclidean projection onto that simplex.
selectionObjective.tieBreak: smaller h, then smallest accepted TopK

training.splitPolicy: Fit, development, and heldout remain speaker- and sentence-disjoint according to source_manifest.json.
